notes.title: Free upgrade for all!
notes.notes:
Hi all good people,

Thanks for believing in me and your patience!

I just want to update really quickly: I'm working on a remake. Remake will bring many quality of life improvements along with improved playability of the game.

All purchases of current version [b][i]will get free and automatic upgrade[/i][/b] to latest version once it is published!

Along with this update I'm posting one picture of current development process.
There is new (better) engine, reworked tasking, panels... many many improvements!

notes.title: Sneak peak - ow my gawd
notes.notes:
Hello good people,

I'm sharing with you small screenshot of current porting process to a new engine. It is not much, but at least I can confirm I'm making progress. Currently, I have movement already done, with placement of workers/machines  and few basic windows. The basic logic is happening already!

In this rework, I'm gonna focus on what matters - playability!

Se you soon! Follow for more updates!

notes.title: Rework in progress
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just want to drop by this message. I have been very busy - but still manage to squeeze hours for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859605/1855d20c47cf31a06ed02458fe90254c14974a0a.png[/img]


So basically, I'm rewriting the game. I'm not personally satisfied how it turned out.
Im working on a update of following:
- switching to a game engine: this is a big one. decided to leave my custom game engine for a full featured game engine. this will take some time, but I'm progressing in a quite good pace
- simplified game logic: the game will be more simple to play, but the challenges will remain
- custom beer recipes: I'm implementing the change for everyone to be able to design its own beer.
beer will be able to be designed and sold to market
- pipes! yes piping to connect the machines should be in place. no more only workers will carry the materials inside factory. after all we are beer brewing business.
- graphics improvements
- many quality of life bugfixes: so you wont be bothered with resolution change etc!

stay tuned, and please drop me a message anytime!

notes.title: Bugfixes arriving
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Im listening very carefully to what users are saying and will be publishing and update soon.
This first update will consist of bug fixes, especially the ones imacting gameplay. I'm aware there is resulution change bug so please if you would like to play in full screen select it from the menu options, dont resize the window, it will change the resolution in a bad way and mess up the mouse coordinate.
Along with this update, I will fix some other bugs, too.

Thank you for your patience!
